notes.title: Big update
notes.notes:
We apologize for the infrequent updates and bugs. The complexity of creating such an ambitious online game turned out to be higher than we expected, and we have to develop it only in our free time.
We have made many changes in game mechanics, graphics and fixed a huge number of all sorts of bugs. However, there are still many things that need to be fixed, we hope for your understanding.
We listen to all feedback, both on Steam and in our Discord, feel free to join in.
